archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Jewel & Luxury (High-End Terminal Aesthetic)
brand_concept: Synthesis + Code. A futuristic command center for multi-AI orchestration. Mixing editorial elegance with brutalist IDE precision.

headings.usage: Hero headings, project titles, main section headers. Creates an elegant, human contrast against the cold tech.

body_ui.usage: Chat interface, sidebar navigation, system messages, code snippets, file structure.

accent_labels.usage: Tiny overlines, AI names, ULTRA mode tag, primary CTA buttons. ALWAYS uppercase with wide tracking.

main_workspace.structure: 3-column CSS Grid (sidebar | chat | live preview). Optional 4th technical panel on right.
main_workspace.left_sidebar: w-64 border-r border-white/10 bg-[#050505] flex flex-col justify-between p-4
main_workspace.chat_column: w-96 border-r border-white/10 bg-[#0D0D0D] flex flex-col relative

layout_architecture.spacing_system: Dense for the IDE parts (gap-2, p-3), generous for the landing page (py-24, gap-12).

component_strategies.buttons: Flat background, 1px solid border. Hover state MUST explicitly change text color and background. No soft shadows. Example: bg-white text-black hover:bg-[#D4D4D8].
component_strategies.inputs_and_chat: Input fields must use JetBrains Mono. 1px border-white/20, focus:border-white focus:ring-0. Chat bubbles should not look like iMessage; use brutalist rectangular blocks.
component_strategies.ai_selector_cards: Grid of rectangular cards. When active, 1px border highlights in the AI's specific color (e.g., border-[#10A37F] for ChatGPT).
component_strategies.live_preview: Rendered inside an iframe or a scaled div. It MUST have a white/light background to contrast with the dark IDE shell, making the 'created product' pop out.
component_strategies.file_upload_zone: Dashed border-white/20 with a hover state of border-white. Display supported formats (Excel, PDF, JPG, ZIP) in tiny monospace uppercase.
component_strategies.system_messages: Transparencia operativa ('analizando proyecto...', 'estructurando componentes...'). Use a typewriter effect or a blinking terminal cursor block '█'.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Translate-y is banned for IDE buttons. Use border color changes or background fill inversions.
motion_and_interactions.chat_generation: Staggered fade-in for AI messages. Skeleton loaders for code blocks.
motion_and_interactions.ultra_mode_activation: When toggled, trigger a visual 'boot-up' sequence. Subtle white glow across the UI borders, indicating all AIs are synchronized.

media_and_assets.icons_library: phosphor-icons or lucide-react. Use sharp, unrounded variants where possible.

landing_hero_bg.description: Abstract neon digital landscape for the Landing Page hero background. Use with heavy bg-black/70 overlay.

template_ecommerce.description: Preview image for the E-commerce Template in the templates gallery.

template_restaurant.description: Preview image for the Restaurant Template in the templates gallery.

template_dashboard.description: Preview image for the Dashboard / SaaS Template.

specific_page_instructions.landing_page: High visual impact. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' at massive scale (text-6xl+) for the hero text. Background should be the dark abstract tech image with a heavy vignette. Marquee ribbon showing 'SÍNTESIS EN TIEMPO REAL • MÚLTIPLES MODELOS • ARQUITECTURA ULTRA •'.
specific_page_instructions.auth_pages: Minimalist terminal style. Black background, centered square form. No cards, just pure grid borders.
specific_page_instructions.workspace_chat: User input at bottom, chat history above. Distinguish user messages (right-aligned, plain text) from AI messages (left-aligned, monospaced, colored border based on which AI responded).
specific_page_instructions.workspace_preview: This is the 'live' project. Wrap it in a container that looks like a browser window or a clean frame. Must have a 'Compare' button and 'Version History' dropdown in its header.
specific_page_instructions.technical_panel: Optional right sidebar. Show a mock file tree (JetBrains Mono, tiny text), dependency list, and real-time logs.
specific_page_instructions.settings_page: Bento grid layout for API keys, billing, and profile. Use strict grid lines.

testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially monospace system messages, passes APCA contrast on the deep black background.
testing_and_accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all buttons, chat inputs, AI selector cards, template thumbnails, and navigation links. Use kebab-case.
